(ii) For the twist E^{-7}, every stated hypothesis of ExactBSD Thm 1.1 (some s_q in {0,1}), Prop 10.4 (a(E) in {0,1}, p odd, non-CM for the Section-5 branch) and TwoPrimary Thm 1.1 (s_2 <= 1) holds at every prime -- 2 (I1*), 3 (split I2), 7 (I0*, conductor 49N), 2243 (nonsplit I1), 4547 (type III), 5843 (split I2), good ordinary, good supersingular -- from L(E^{-7},1) != 0 [PROVED_COMPUTER_ASSISTED] and GZK [published]; no stated hypothesis (squarefree conductor, semistability, p ∤ N, p >= 5, rho-bar image, torsion, ordinarity) is imposed by the manuscripts and none fails.
